<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A table reservation: name, phone and/or email, date, time, guests, optional notes and consent; in the split
  layout, the ways to reach the house sit beside the form. Axes: layout (single, split), density, fields (full,
  compact).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ReservationLabels } from "./reservation-form.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type ReservationFormProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    labels: ReservationLabels;
    details: Feature[];
    layout?: "single" | "split";
    fields?: "full" | "compact";
    terms?: "show" | "hide";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Checkbox from "../compose/Checkbox.svelte";
  import Form from "../compose/Form.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Input from "../compose/Input.svelte";
  import Label from "../compose/Label.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Textarea from "../compose/Textarea.svelte";
  import Field from "../components/field.svelte";
  import NumberField from "../components/number-field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    labels,
    details,
    layout = "single",
    fields = "full",
    terms = "hide",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ReservationFormProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={text}
  density={density}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "single") ? "xl" : "default")}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "1-2" : "1")} class="items-start gap-8">
    <Form method="dialog" class="flex w-full flex-col gap-4" data-slot="reservation-form">
      <Field label={labels.name} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-name", id)}>
        <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" id={tpl("{0}-name", id)} data-slot="field" />
      </Field>
      <Field label={labels.phone} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-phone", id)}>
        <Input type="tel" name="phone" autocomplete="tel" id={tpl("{0}-phone", id)} data-slot="field" />
      </Field>
      {#if ((fields as string) === "full")}
        <Field label={labels.email} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-email", id)}>
          <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-slot="field" />
        </Field>
      {/if}
      <Group gap="4" class="flex-wrap">
        <Box class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <Field label={labels.date} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-date", id)}>
            <Input type="date" name="date" id={tpl("{0}-date", id)} data-slot="field" />
          </Field>
        </Box>
        <Box class="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <Field label={labels.time} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-time", id)}>
            <Input type="time" name="time" id={tpl("{0}-time", id)} data-slot="field" />
          </Field>
        </Box>
      </Group>
      <Stack gap="2">
        <Label class="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
          {labels.guests}
        </Label>
        <NumberField
          value="2"
          name={tpl("{0}-guests", id)}
          min="1"
          label={labels.guests}
          decrease={labels.decrease}
          increase={labels.increase}
        />
      </Stack>
      {#if ((fields as string) === "full")}
        <Field label={labels.notes} htmlFor={tpl("{0}-notes", id)}>
          <Textarea rows={4} name="notes" id={tpl("{0}-notes", id)} data-slot="field" />
        </Field>
      {/if}
      {#if ((terms as string) === "show")}
        <Group gap="2" align="center" class={cn("w-fit", "")}>
          <Checkbox name="consent" id={tpl("{0}-consent", id)} />
          <Label for={tpl("{0}-consent", id)} class="text-sm">
            {labels.consent}
          </Label>
        </Group>
      {/if}
      <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit" class="w-fit">
        {labels.submit}
      </Button>
    </Form>
    {#if (((layout as string) === "split") && ((details?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
      <Stack gap="4" data-slot="details">
        {#each details as d (d.id)}
          <Group gap="4" align="start" data-slot="detail">
            <LucideIcon name={d.icon} size={20} />
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                {d.title}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {d.text}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    {/if}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
